### Initial decisions: 

- `centroid_threshold_km <- 1`: We treat Maavara and MERIT catchments with centroids more than 1 km apart as mismatched, because this is a conservative spatial-identity filter meant to remove COMIDs where shared IDs may not represent the same landscape unit.

- `min_reaches <- 10`: We require at least 10 reaches for a monthly HUC-level allometry fit to be interpretable, because smaller samples can produce unstable slopes and misleading high or low \(R^2\) values.

- `min_valid_months <- 6`: We require at least 6 valid months for a HUC to be considered seasonally supported, because this prevents conclusions from being driven by only one or a few months of coherent behavior.


```{r 3}

## Some options
### Jemez River - 13020202
target_huc <- "13020202"  # replace with one HUC8
centroid_threshold_km <- 1
min_reaches <- 10
min_valid_months <- 6

path_maavara_cat <- "../data/raw/dryad_data/MERIT_Hydro_CONUS_catchments/MERIT_Hydro_CONUS_catchments.shp"
path_merit_cat <- file.path("../data/processed/merit_data/cat_pfaf_7_MERIT_Hydro_v07_Basins_v01_CONUS.shp")
path_merit_riv <- file.path("../data//oricessedmerit_data/riv_pfaf_7_MERIT_Hydro_v07_Basins_v01_CONUS.shp")
path_metabolism <- "../data/processed/03_maavara_monthly_metabolism.rds"
path_characteristics <- "../data/dryad_data/scaling_dataset_Qmonth_06082024.csv"
path_existing_metrics <- "../data/processed/06_huc08_allometry_metrics.csv"
```


```{r 4}
maavara_cat <- read_sf(path_maavara_cat) |>
  clean_names() |>
  mutate(comid = as.character(comid))

merit_cat <- read_sf(path_merit_cat) |>
  clean_names() |>
  mutate(comid = as.character(comid)) |>
  filter(comid %in% maavara_cat$comid)

merit_riv <- read_sf(path_merit_riv) |>
  clean_names() |>
  mutate(
    comid = as.character(comid),
    nxt_dw = as.character(nxt_dw)
  ) |>
  filter(comid %in% maavara_cat$comid)

metabolism <- readRDS(path_metabolism) |>
  mutate(comid = as.character(comid))

comid_characteristics <- read_csv(path_characteristics, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  clean_names() |>
  mutate(
    comid = as.character(comid),
    stream_area_m2 = lengthkm * 1000 * merit_width
  ) |>
  select(comid, unitarea, uparea, lengthkm, merit_width, order, merit_qmean, stream_area_m2)

tibble(
  data_object = c("Maavara catchments", "MERIT catchments", "MERIT rivers", "Monthly metabolism"),
  n_rows = c(nrow(maavara_cat), nrow(merit_cat), nrow(merit_riv), nrow(metabolism)),
  n_comids = c(n_distinct(maavara_cat$comid), n_distinct(merit_cat$comid),
               n_distinct(merit_riv$comid), n_distinct(metabolism$comid))
) |>
  kable()
```
